temporal.reason: The ontology snapshot has no observation time.

relevance_rule.statement: A concrete query set is relevant to an abstract synset exactly when that synset lies in the intersection of the seeds' hypernym closures at depth 1 through 3. An empty intersection is ineligible for task association.

baselines_declared_not_run.description: Exact k-retrieval using the saved vector of the first concrete source id, in ascending id order, as the query point on this abstract corpus.
Rank abstract entries by the count of shared lowercase letter-tokens between the joined seed lemmas and the entry members plus definitions, then by ascending source id. This baseline reads text only.
